instruction: Adjust the default zoom in LibreOffice Writer so that it is 120%.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the default zoom level for LibreOffice Writer to 120%. The evaluator reads the registrymodifications.xcu file and checks if the Zoom/Value setting is set to 120. This is similar in complexity to the original task, requiring configuration file modification through the LibreOffice settings interface.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator can correctly verify the instruction requirement of changing zoom to 120%
Getter correctly reads the registrymodifications.xcu config file and extracts zoom level using correct XPath pattern (/org.openoffice.Office.Writer/Zoom)
Getter includes fallback logic to search alternative locations for zoom settings, making it robust
Metric correctly handles the expected parameter - when expected.type='rule', the framework passes the rules dict directly, so expected.get('zoom_level') is the correct access pattern
Expected value is semantically correct: 120 matches the instruction requirement exactly
Postconfig is properly configured: kills LibreOffice process (pkill -f soffice.bin; sleep 1) to ensure settings are flushed to disk before verification
Complete coverage: instruction has single requirement (zoom=120%) and evaluator checks exactly that
Data flow is semantically correct: user changes zoom → postconfig kills LibreOffice → settings written to XML → getter reads XML → metric compares to 120
